meta_description: Install VpnHood! CONNECT on Linux with one command, sign in to your Premium account, and connect from its window or the command line.
title: Install VpnHood! CONNECT on Linux
lead: One command installs the app, with its window and a set of commands. Sign in once from the window, then connect from either.
before_need: A Premium plan, as the Linux version does not have any free servers: upgrade to Premium.
connect_desktop: Open [app] from the application menu, sign in to your Premium account and connect.
connect_terminal: Once you have signed in, you can also connect from a terminal, and check the connection:
connect_note: Signing in needs the app's window, so a machine with no desktop cannot use [app] yet. There you can use VpnHood! CLIENT with your own server.
